title: The doorframe test: can you pull yourself in 8 times?
caption: Back workout with a doorframe: lean back, pull yourself in, and count to 8. Take the doorframe test, then find your level: Shoulder Blade Squeeze, Doorframe Lean Row, Doorframe Row or Deep Doorframe Row. Save this and retest in two weeks.

overlays.text: Can you lean back from a doorframe and pull yourself in 8 times? Try it, then swipe.

scenes.footer: Notice two things: how far you could lean, and how many you did.

overlays.text: Hold both sides of a solid frame, feet close. Lean back, pull your chest in, count.

scenes.footer: Do this every day. Move on when all 12 feel easy.

overlays.text: Start here. Shoulder Blade Squeeze. 12 reps. Draw your shoulder blades together, let go.

scenes.footer: Move on when you can lean further and still get all 10.

overlays.text: Doorframe Lean Row. 10 reps. Feet near the frame, lean back a little, pull yourself in.

scenes.footer: Move on when all 8 feel easy at your deepest lean.

overlays.text: Doorframe Row. 8 reps. Walk your feet closer, lean back more, pull your chest in.

scenes.footer: You passed. This is your next rung.

overlays.text: Deep Doorframe Row. 8 reps. Feet closer still, a deeper lean, slow on the way back.

scenes.footer: Same frame, same lean. Write down your count.

overlays.text: Do your level every day. Take the doorframe test again in two weeks.

scenes.footer: Save this and retest in two weeks.
